resources.string: A letter or a word today keeps it going.
A letter or a word today starts a streak.
One reminder a day at the time you chose, only if you have not practised yet.
One quiet reminder a day, and none once you have practised. Made on this phone; nothing is sent anywhere.
Notifications are turned off for Handspell. Allow them in system settings to get the reminder.
Android will ask whether Handspell may show notifications. Handspell only uses this for the one daily streak reminder you turned on, and you can turn it off here at any time.
